title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Custom Email Signatures in the Sales Order Agent

features.name: Custom Email Signatures in Sales Order Agent
features.description: Ability to define a custom signature that will be automatically included in all generated messages from the sales order agent. The signature can be specific to a sales consultant or a generic company signature and can include text, images, hyperlinks, or other professional email elements.
caveats: Signature is appended only to the first reply from the agent
System validates content to prevent harmful or inappropriate material

features.name: Signature Content Validation
features.description: The system automatically validates signature content upon save to ensure nothing harmful or inappropriate has been included, preventing the signature from being saved if issues are detected.
